The chart shows the percentage of guests from abroad from January to June.

In January, the percentage was 40%. It increased slightly to 42% in February. In March, it rose to 48%, and continued to increase to 50% in April. In May, it reached 55%, and finally increased to 60% in June.

Overall, the percentage of foreign guests increased steadily over the six months. June had the highest percentage.
The chart shows the number of hotel staff from 2021 to 2025.

In 2021, the hotel had 25 staff members. The number increased to 30 in 2022 and remained the same in 2023. In 2024, it increased to 38 staff members. Finally, in 2025, the number reached 45.

Overall, the number of hotel staff increased over the five years. The highest number was in 2025.
